1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of __greater than 500 Da and less than 2000 Da__ and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a __multivalent metal cation__ crosslinker.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __a polyethylenimine with a molecular weight of less than 2000 Da__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and __other anionic polymers__.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex __nanoparticle has an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter__.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a __multivalent cation selected from the group consisting of Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe, or Al__.

20) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a delayed gelling agent comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyethylenimine of __greater than 500 Da and less than 2000 Da__ and a polyvinyl sulfonate intimately associated with a multivalent metal cation crosslinker, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron; b) a polymer having anionic sites that can be crosslinked with said metal cation crosslinker; and c) a fluid.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __that can be crosslinked with the delayed gelling agent__; and c) a fluid.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, __acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid__, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or N,N-dimethylacrylamide.
